title: AeroJEPA: A Two-Stage Framework for Aerosol Forecasting with Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30891v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aerosol forecasting requires integrating sparse ground observations and modeling meteorologically driven concentration evolution and spatial structure. However, analysis-initialized forecasts make limited explicit use of historical observations, while pointwise regression tends to smooth local variations and provides limited constraints on fine spatial structures. In this work, we propose AeroJEPA, a two-stage joint-embedding predictive framework for regional surface PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting. Specifically, Stage I fuses historical observations, model backgrounds, and meteorological information to predict an initial future state, meteorological conditions, and multi-scale structures. Morphology-guided encoding and joint-embedding predictive supervision support learning future spatial representations, supplementing concentration regression with structural constraints. translated_title: AeroJEPA：一种基于联合嵌入预测学习的两阶段气溶胶预报框架
translated_abstract: 气溶胶预报需要融合稀疏的地面观测数据，并对气象驱动的浓度演变及空间结构进行建模。然而，以分析场初始化的预报方法对历史观测的显式利用十分有限，而逐点回归则容易平滑局部变化，对精细空间结构的约束也较为有限。在本工作中，我们提出了 AeroJEPA，一个面向区域地表 PM2.5 预报的两阶段联合嵌入预测框架。具体而言，第一阶段融合历史观测、模式背景场和气象信息，以预测初始未来状态、气象条件及多尺度结构。形态学引导的编码与联合嵌入预测监督支持对未来空间表征的学习，以结构约束补充浓度回归。第二阶段利用预测的气象条件引导状态精化，并结合……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 AeroJEPA 两阶段联合嵌入预测框架，通过形态引导编码和联合嵌入预测监督为区域 PM2.5 预报引入空间结构约束，解决了传统预报对历史观测利用不足以及逐点回归平滑局部变化、缺乏精细空间结构约束的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AeroJEPA, a two-stage joint-embedding predictive framework for regional surface PM2.5 forecasting that leverages morphology-guided encoding and joint-embedding predictive supervision to add spatial structure constraints, addressing the limited explicit use of historical observations in analysis-initialized forecasts and the smoothing of local variations in pointwise regression.
